title: Tracecat 1.1.0-alpha.1.2
body_markdown:
Hotfixes for` 1.1.0-alpha.1.1` . No migrations, database-schema changes, backfills, or new registry actions.


## Case management


- fix(cases): Hide Mermaid source alongside rendered diagrams ([#3542](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3542) )
- fix(cases): Strip NUL bytes from case comment content ([#3594](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3594) )


## Tables


- fix(tables): Bind lookup values with column types ([#3567](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3567) )


## Agents


- fix(agents): Preserve Slack errors during runtime cleanup ([#3556](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3556) )
- fix(agents+integrations): Surface and block custom actions shadowing builtins ([#3579](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3579) )
- fix(agents): Distinguish gateway cooldown from provider throttling ([#3538](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3538) )
- fix(agents): Preserve chunked HTTP request bodies ([#3610](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3610) )


## Core actions


- fix(actions): Add region_name and cap threads in DuckDB action ([#3559](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3559) )


## Engine


- fix(engine): Surface workload stderr in sandbox workload failures ([#3595](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3595) )


## API


- fix(ui+api): Show real item counts on workflow folders ([#3571](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3571) )


## User interface


- fix(ui): Stop toasting 403 responses ([#3557](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3557) )
- fix(ui): Allow mouse wheel scrolling in folder picker dropdowns ([#3569](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3569) )
- fix(ui): Use official Google SecOps logo for Google Chronicle ([#3585](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3585) )


## Infrastructure


- ci: Publish releases from branches and guard latest ([#3560](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3560) )


## Documentation


- docs: Clarify alpha hotfix release branches ([#3611](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3611) )


Backport scope:[#3611](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3611) contributes only the registry alpha-hotfix version-comparison fix and tests;[#3560](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3560) contributes only the image publisher and tests.


**Full changelog** :[1.1.0-alpha.1.1...1.1.0-alpha.1.2](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.1.0-alpha.1.1...1.1.0-alpha.1.2)
